target_project.value: Online Course Enrollment Portal (Problem Statement 7) — Web-based academic platform supporting student registration, searchable course listings, automated enrollment management, timetable conflict detection, and an admin dashboard.

student_registration.value: Student Registration Module: Manages student onboarding, unique ID generation (STU-xxx), degree major selection, contact email, and completed prerequisite tracking.

course_listings.value: Course Listings Module: Searchable course catalog displaying course codes (CS101, CS201, MATH101, PHY101, ENG101), titles, assigned instructors, credit values (1-4 credits), room capacities, and weekly meeting time slots.

enrollment_management.value: Enrollment Management Module: Handles course add/drop operations, validates completed prerequisites, enforces maximum 18-credit per semester limits, and automatically invokes the conflict detection engine before confirming registration.

admin_dashboard.value: Admin Dashboard Module: Comprehensive administrative portal for department chairs and registrars to create/update courses, assign faculty instructors, monitor room capacities, review enrollment stats, and override waitlists.

conflict_detection_engine.value: AI Scheduling Conflict Detector: Analyzes student timetable slots for overlapping days and time intervals (e.g. CS101 on Mon/Wed 09:00-10:30 vs MATH101 on Mon/Wed 10:00-11:30) using interval collision logic max(start1, start2) < min(end1, end2) to prevent timetable clashes.

development_roadmap.value: Development Roadmap: Phase 1: Database Schema & Student Registration; Phase 2: Course Listings & Catalog Search; Phase 3: Enrollment Engine & Scheduling Conflict Detection; Phase 4: Admin Dashboard, Analytics & Deployment.

scheduling_rules.value: Core academic policies: 1) Overlap Constraint: Courses with overlapping time intervals on the same weekday are disallowed. 2) Credit Limit: Maximum 18 credits per semester. 3) Capacity Limit: Enrollment cannot exceed maximum room capacity.

backend_framework.value: Python 3.12, FastAPI, and Pydantic domain models for the Online Course Enrollment Portal backend.

llm_architecture.value: Hybrid LLM architecture with local Nemotron & Groq cloud fallback for intelligent timetable conflict resolution.

decisions.title: Adopt Interval Collision Algorithm for Timetable Conflict Detection
decisions.description: Implemented deterministic interval overlap detection comparing start and end minutes on matching weekdays to prevent scheduling conflicts during course enrollment.
decisions.rationale: Prevents double-booking students and guarantees instantaneous conflict feedback before database commit.

decisions.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Student vs Admin Portals
decisions.description: Partitioned the course portal into Student Views (catalog browsing, enrollment) and Admin Views (course authoring, capacity overrides, reports).
decisions.rationale: Ensures academic security and prevents unauthorized modification of course limits or grades.

decisions.title: Four-Phase Agile Development Roadmap for Course Portal
decisions.description: Adopted a 4-phase milestone roadmap covering Auth/Schema (Sprint 1), Catalog Search (Sprint 2), Conflict Detection Engine (Sprint 3), and Admin Dashboard (Sprint 4).
decisions.rationale: Enables modular verification of the conflict detector before assembling the complete web interface.
